stories.title: Handle Missing and Inconsistent Board Certification Data
stories.description: Implement fallback and normalization logic for incomplete, missing, or inconsistent board certification data from NPI registry responses, ensuring safe defaults and clear flags for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Integrate Board Certification into Provider Detail Service Output
stories.description: Embed normalized board certification verification results into the provider_detail_service response model, ensuring compatibility with existing provider detail structure.

stories.title: Integration Test for Board Certification Verification Flow
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow from NPI registry fetch through normalization, service integration, and facade exposure, ensuring board certification data is correctly delivered in provider detail responses.
